facts.business: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL) provides telecommunication services including fixed telephone, mobile, enterprise business, and infrastructure leasing in Delhi and Mumbai circles.

auditor.name: M/s O. P. Bagla & Co. LLP and M/s S.L. Chhajed & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Adverse opinion due to material uncertainty related to going concern; net worth fully eroded, current liabilities exceed current assets, accumulated losses, and inability to meet liabilities as they fall due. Internal audit system not commensurate with size and nature of business.

key_risks: Market/Technology risk: Rapidly evolving technology, obsolete network, heavy debt burden and recurring losses leading to financial crunch
Going concern risk: Accumulated losses, negative net worth, current liabilities exceeding current assets, material uncertainty on ability to meet liabilities
Internal control risk: Internal audit system not commensurate with size and nature of business; extent of coverage, frequency/quality/timeliness of reporting and follow-up need strengthening
Regulatory/Compliance risk: Compliance with SEBI LODR, Companies Act, and other statutory provisions
facts.related_party_note: Service Agreement between MTNL & BSNL dated 22.11.2024 under which BSNL undertakes maintenance and operational activities of MTNL's telecom services w.e.f. 01.01.2025; BSNL to invest CAPEX and OPEX for smooth running of operations in Delhi and Mumbai.
